name: PIXEL
summary: A chiptune machine. Write drums, bass, chords and a lead on a grid, chain the bars into a song, and turn the knob to hear it on eight old sound chips.
author: willbearfruits
status_note: Flashed on a rev C Stack on 2026-11-10: it starts, plays and keeps up (13 % CPU on the AMIGA console). Not played much yet; the other consoles' load and the link have not been measured on a board. Rev E's left knob (the cursor in the editor, the tempo in play) and hand (the breakdown) are tested in the simulator only: no rev E board has run them.
hardware_note: Writing is easiest with the joystick (rev C) or the two knobs of rev E; with neither, the one knob moves the cursor.
